Order is by chosen action (roll + speed + init bonus/mods); lower acts first. THAC0: lower is better. Pick an action to roll its d20; green hits the chosen Target (roll ≥ THAC0 − AC). New Rolls re-rolls the dice for every checked action, keeping picks and conditions.
Proficiency check: roll d20 at or under the target. Cells show the margin (target − roll): green succeeds, rust fails; +15 or better is a critical success, −15 or worse a critical failure.
Saving throw: roll d20 at or above the target. Modifiers are applied to the target (a +2 bonus lowers it by 2).

DMG Table 59: 2d10, minus Charisma reaction adjustment and situational modifiers (lower is friendlier), read in the column for how the party is behaving.
Character sheetsImport players' exported character sheet saves (.json). Their stats replace the hand-typed ones below and stay in this browser until removed. Your own settings (parry, armor spell, virtue, hidden by default, init bonus, turning) are kept.
CharactersChecked characters appear on every tab; unchecked are hidden and left out of the initiative order.
